Every public name of the `pycyxwiz` module in this build, pycyxwiz 0.2.0, with the signature and description the module itself reports. The top-level names (`pycyxwiz.Tensor`, `pycyxwiz.Sequential`, ...) are grouped by what they do; each submodule (`pycyxwiz.linalg`, `pycyxwiz.signal`, ...) has its own page.

To learn the library, start with the [Python library guide](../index.md) and the [quickstart](../quickstart.md). Python nodes use mainly `Tensor`, `Module`, `gradcheck` and [`pycyxwiz.nodes`](nodes.md); [Tensor operations for nodes](../../sdk/tensor-operations.md) lists the tensor operations next to their C++ names.

| Page | What it holds |
|---|---|
| [Tensors and devices](tensors-and-devices.md) | The Tensor class, the compute devices and starting the backend. |
| [Modules and Sequential models](modules-and-models.md) | Module, the built-in modules, the Sequential model and the gradient checks. |
| [Layers](layers.md) | The layer classes: dense, convolution, pooling, normalization, recurrent and attention layers. |
| [Activations and tensor functions](activations.md) | The activation classes and the activation, dropout and flatten functions on tensors. |
| [Losses](losses.md) | The loss classes and their options. |
| [Optimizers](optimizers.md) | The optimizers, learning rate warmup and the optimizer factory. |
| [Data loading](data-loading.md) | The DuckDB data loader: CSV, Parquet and JSON files, SQL queries and batches. |
| [Audio](audio.md) | Loading audio, spectrograms, mel spectrograms, MFCCs and audio augmentation. |
| [Tokenizers and vocabularies](tokenizers.md) | Text tokenizers and vocabularies. |
| [Reinforcement learning](rl.md) | Replay buffers, exploration schedules, RL metrics and plugin environments as Gymnasium environments. |
| [pycyxwiz.calculus](calculus.md) | Integrals, derivatives and curvature of a typed formula. |
| [pycyxwiz.distributed](distributed.md) | Distributed training support for data parallel training. |
| [pycyxwiz.linalg](linalg.md) | Linear algebra functions (MATLAB-style). |
| [pycyxwiz.model](model.md) | The model's summary, learning rate range test, explanations and calibration (the Engine's Tools > Model and Results > Test > Calibration). |
| [pycyxwiz.nodes](nodes.md) | Describe a Python module as a CyxWiz node. |
| [pycyxwiz.optimize](optimize.md) | Linear and quadratic programs (HiGHS) and the training optimizers' paths. |
| [pycyxwiz.signal](signal.md) | Signal processing functions (MATLAB-style). |
| [pycyxwiz.stats](stats.md) | Statistics and clustering functions. |
| [pycyxwiz.system](system.md) | The Engine's memory: what it holds on the compute device, what the device has free, host tensors. |
| [pycyxwiz.text](text.md) | Words, terms, stop words, Porter stems and VADER sentiment. |
| [pycyxwiz.timeseries](timeseries.md) | Time series analysis functions. |
| [pycyxwiz.utilities](utilities.md) | Tools > Utilities from Python: units, hashes, JSON, regex, seeded random values, UUIDs, the calculator. |
